summary: Independent review of Jinshu 53 chronology for Sima Yu and the seventy related figures. Year-level conversions hold: 惠帝即位 is AD 290; 元康元年 is AD 291; Yuankang 9/xii through Yongkang 1 (明年正月, 三月, 四月, 六月) are AD 300 because that twelfth lunar month begins 300-01-08, not the conventional 299 reign-year label; 永寧/永甯元年 is AD 301; 太安元年三月 and 太安初 are AD 302 as the renxu year-label. January 300 has a 0-day Julian/proleptic-Gregorian offset; later 300–302 months differ by one day but not in Western year. Ages 五歲 and 二十三 remain sui without inferred births. Undated childhood, Guangling staff, marriage, and exemplum notices are correctly unmarked by year. Retrospective reception (restoration edict parallels, appraisal comparisons, 追封/追諡) is kept off living hints. Annals give competing days or months—六月壬寅 versus this chapter’s 己卯 for the burial, 五月己巳 versus 己巳 after 四月 for Zang’s heirship, 五月 versus 八月 for Shang’s heirship—but they do not disturb the year-level claims. No omitted birth, death, or age that this chapter actually dates was found, and active hints track supported personal events rather than dynasty-long windows.

references.title: 元康 (西晋)

references.reason: Establishes that Yongkang 1 began on the first day of the (would-be) Yuankang 10th year in AD 300, so the preceding Yuankang 9 twelfth month sits at the 299/300 New Year boundary. The same page’s lunar table places that twelfth-month first day at 300/1/8.

references.title: 永康 (西晋)

references.reason: Confirms Yongkang as Hui’s era for AD 300–301/iv and supplies first-day Western mappings used to keep 正月/三月/四月/六月 of Yongkang 1 inside AD 300.
